title: Nicaraguan Revolution
summary: The killing of newspaper publisher Pedro Joaquín Chamorro in January 1978 set off demonstrations that grew into civil war against President Anastasio Somoza, a close US ally. In July 1979 the Sandinista movement prevailed, and the Somoza regime fell. The US under Carter tried to moderate the outcome.

uncertainty.note: Phase covered is the 1978-79 uprising and overthrow; the wider revolutionary process is dated differently by other accounts and is not covered here.
